statement: The consent record shows PT-119's status as "active," but since PT-119 withdrew in writing yesterday and withdrawn participants' data may not be used, I will ensure their data is excluded.
judge_text:
WRONG
It flags the contradiction — "the consent record shows PT-119's status as 'active,' but since PT-119 withdrew in writing yesterday" — and acts on withdrawal instead of the recorded value.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
